error: ValueError: Mask must have boolean scalar type in Triton tl.store
location: native_writer.py Triton kernel, tl.store with mask=writable
root_cause: writable is a scalar boolean expression (valid & bank>=0 & ...), but tl.store with vector pointers needs vector-shaped masks
fix: Broadcast scalar to vector: mask=writable & (latent_col >= 0). latent_col >= 0 is always True for tl.arange, so this effectively broadcasts writable.
